clank.name: Clank
clank.description: Clanks are sentient mechanical beings built from a variety of materials, including metal, wood, and stone. They can resemble humanoids, animals, or even inanimate objects.

features.name: Purposeful Design
features.description: Decide who made you and for what purpose. At character creation, choose one of your Experiences that best aligns with this purpose and gain a permanent +1 bonus to it.

features.name: Efficient
features.description: When you take a short rest, you can choose a long rest move instead of a short rest move.

drakona.name: Drakona
drakona.description: Drakona resemble wingless dragons in humanoid form and possess a powerful elemental breath. All drakona have thick scales that provide excellent natural armor.

features.name: Scales
features.description: Your scales act as natural protection. When you would take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

features.name: Elemental Breath
features.description: Choose an element for your breath (such as electricity, fire, or ice). You can use this breath against a target or group of targets within Very Close range, treating it as an Instinct weapon that deals d8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Dwarves are short humanoids with square frames, dense musculature, and thick hair. Their skin and nails contain high keratin, making them naturally resilient.

features.name: Thick Skin
features.description: When you take Minor damage, you can mark 2 Stress instead of marking a Hit Point.

features.name: Increased Fortitude
features.description: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Elves are typically tall humanoids with pointed ears and acutely attuned senses. All elves can drop into a celestial trance rather than sleep.

features.name: Quick Reactions
features.description: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.

features.name: Celestial Trance
features.description: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

faerie.name: Faerie
faerie.description: Faeries are winged humanoid creatures with insectile features. They possess characteristics ranging from additional arms, compound eyes, lantern organs, chitinous exoskeletons, or stingers.

features.name: Luckbender
features.description: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.

features.name: Wings
features.description: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

faun.name: Faun
faun.description: Fauns resemble humanoid goats with curving horns, square pupils, and cloven hooves. Most have a humanoid torso and a goatlike lower body covered in dense fur.

features.name: Caprine Leap
features.description: You can leap anywhere within Close range as though you were using normal movement, allowing you to vault obstacles, jump across gaps, or scale barriers with ease.

features.name: Kick
features.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to kick yourself off them, dealing an extra 2d6 damage and knocking back either yourself or the target to Very Close range.

firbolg.name: Firbolg
firbolg.description: Firbolgs are bovine humanoids typically recognized by their broad noses and long, drooping ears. They are tall and muscular with remarkable strength.

features.name: Charge
features.description: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far range into Melee range with one or more targets, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d12 physical damage to all targets within Melee range.

features.name: Unshakable
features.description: When you would mark a Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 6, don't mark it.

fungril.name: Fungril
fungril.description: Fungril resemble humanoid mushrooms. They come in an assortment of colors and can communicate nonverbally through a mycelial array.

features.name: Fungril Network
features.description: Make an Instinct Roll (12) to use your mycelial array to speak with others of your ancestry. On a success, you can communicate across any distance.

features.name: Death Connection
features.description: While touching a corpse that died recently, you can mark a Stress to extract one memory from the corpse related to a specific emotion or sensation of your choice.

galapa.name: Galapa
galapa.description: Galapa resemble anthropomorphic turtles with large, domed shells into which they can retract.

features.name: Shell
features.description: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

features.name: Retract
features.description: Mark a Stress to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: Giants are towering humanoids with broad shoulders, long arms, and one to three eyes. Those with a single eye are commonly known as cyclops.

features.name: Endurance
features.description: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation.

features.name: Reach
features.description: Treat any weapon, ability, spell, or other feature that has a Melee range as though it has a Very Close range instead.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: Goblins are small humanoids recognizable by their large eyes and massive membranous ears. They perceive details at great distances and in darkness.

features.name: Surefooted
features.description: You ignore disadvantage on Agility Rolls.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Halflings are small humanoids with large hairy feet and prominent rounded ears. They are naturally attuned to magnetic fields, granting them a strong internal compass.

features.name: Luckbringer
features.description: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.

features.name: Internal Compass
features.description: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, you can reroll it.

human.name: Human
human.description: Humans are recognized by their dexterous hands, rounded ears, and bodies built for endurance. Humans are physically adaptable and adjust to harsh climates with relative ease.

features.name: High Stamina
features.description: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.

features.name: Adaptability
features.description: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.

infernis.name: Infernis
infernis.description: Infernis are humanoids who possess sharp canine teeth, pointed ears, and horns. They are descendants of demons from the Circles Below.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: When you roll with Fear, you can mark 2 Stress to change it into a roll with Hope instead.

features.name: Dread Visage
features.description: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

katari.name: Katari
katari.description: Katari are feline humanoids with retractable claws, vertically slit pupils, and high, triangular ears.

features.name: Feline Instincts
features.description: When you make an Agility Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.

features.name: Retracting Claws
features.description: Make an Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.

orc.name: Orc
orc.description: Orcs are humanoids recognized by their square features and boar-like tusks that protrude from their lower jaw.

features.name: Sturdy
features.description: When you have 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.

features.name: Tusks
features.description: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Hope to gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra 1d6 damage.

ribbet.name: Ribbet
ribbet.description: Ribbets resemble anthropomorphic frogs with protruding eyes and webbed hands and feet. They primarily move by hopping and can swim with ease.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

features.name: Long Tongue
features.description: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

simiah.name: Simiah
simiah.description: Simiah resemble anthropomorphic monkeys and apes with long limbs and prehensile feet. They are skilled climbers.

features.name: Natural Climber
features.description: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.

features.name: Nimble
features.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.

mixed-ancestry.name: Mixed Ancestry
mixed-ancestry.description: If your character is a descendant of multiple ancestries, work with your GM to choose two features from the ancestries in your character's lineage.

features.name: Mixed Heritage
features.description: Choose the first feature from one ancestry and the second feature from another ancestry in your lineage.
